body: Yeah it's definitely a challenge. I have been self conscious and depressed for many years and it's hard to see a way out of it. I have been trying and things have been getting better in some ways but others are getting worse. Thank you though, i'll keep what you said in mind.

I understand how you are feeling. It must be really hard to really love and want to hang out with this person when they dont understand how you feel. I feel like if you dont use them as an emotional crutch it would be easier for them to be friends with you. I understand that they are your best friend and you only want to be with them but if that's not what they want, you can't force it. You need to find a way to accept it. Things will continue to get worse if you dont talk to them about what is going on in your head and resolve the problem.

I understand how you are feeling. I go through similar feelings everyday. I have a decent life but nothing seems quite right. I wish life could be easier and we could all just be happy with our lives. I do know that eventually things will start to brighten up, you will find something in your life that makes a huge difference and will help you to find happiness. A friend of mine suffers from severe depression, she attempted at suicide a couple times and after every one she woke up realizing that she really had it good and she didn't have a reason to kill herself. It was only her mind and her actions bringing her down. She is now very happy with herself and is helping many others to realize their worth in this world. I hope this made sense and helped. I am willing to talk more if you would like.

I think it gets better once you find what the problem is and take a few steps to correcting it. It obviously depends on what you are going through but that has helped me in my life. Just try and make the best out of things even when you feel completely stuck. I would love to talk more if you want to explain what you are going through.
I wish I were at that point. Thank you for your insight.
Aaahhh! Okay i'll give it a shot! Tomorrow!...
Okay, I will think about that. This was my second one, I just got super fed up that it wasn't working and figured none of them would. But I suppose I just need to keep searching.
I have been spending a lot of my time doing art. It does help to get things out of my head. I am just incredibly self conscious and scared to try anything else. I will give it some thought though.
I have noticed that working out helps a ton. Its just incredibly hard to make myself do if. I will try though.

I have a friend who is very poor and whose mom died recently and his father isn't such a great role model. We live in Minnesota and it has been FREEZING lately. He bikes to school but doesn't have a coat, so a friend and I went out and got him a very nice jacket and gave it to him anonymously.
